articles.summary: U.S. Bank Protect 360 helps clients monitor credit activity, track identity risks and can automatically remove personal information from exposed sites U.S. Bank Protect 360: Key Facts Protect 360 is now available to help clients monitor and take action when credit, identity and privacy risks are found on the dark web. Protect 360 is available within the U.S. Bank Mobile App and online banking experience. The service is available at no additional cost via Protect 360 Essentials, with the option to upgrade to a fee-based Protect 360 Premium subscription to access enhanced protections. articles.summary: Shipper spending rose 5.2% quarter-over-quarter and 32.1% year-over-year, the largest annual increase since 2021 Freight volumes varied sharply by region, while spending increased in every region. Most notably, the Southwest saw a 51.6% year-over-year increase Tighter capacity, rising rates and diesel prices that exceeded $6 per gallon drove higher costs U.S. shippers continue to pay more to move freight even as shipment volumes remain largely unchanged, according to the latest U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index . Third-quarter shipper spending surged 32.1% from a year ago, marking the largest annual increase since 2021, primarily driven by tightened carrier capacity and diesel prices climbing over $6.50 per gallon nationally. National shipment volumes increased both quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year for the first time since 2021, but the gains were modest at 0.4% and 0.5% respectively. “What makes this quarter notable is that outlays are rising much faster than freight volumes,”
articles.title: U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index: Shipper Costs Hit Five-Year High as Freight Demand Stalls

articles.summary: Survey of 150 healthcare leaders finds fragmented payment processes strain staff, disrupt financial performance and position AI as a tool to reduce complexity Key Takeaways: • Digital adoption outpaces billing management: 68% offer nearly all desired payment channels, but only 15% rate revenue cycle performance as excellent. • Complexity drains resources: 76% spend up to 20% of staff time correcting issues, and 83% report disruptions to monthly close. • AI and scalability are priorities: Nearly all plan to explore AI, and 56% prioritize scalability in strategic partners. Healthcare organizations have expanded digital payment options for patients, but the systems behind those transactions are not delivering the same gains in financial performance, according to a new survey released today by Elavon, a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank (NYSE: USB). articles.title: Healthcare digital payment adoption outpaces revenue cycle performance, Elavon survey finds

Clients can switch the payment method directly from the U.S. Bank Mobile App – no need to visit every merchant site. Payment Switch is a component of the Easy Switch solution that helps customers move their banking relationship to U.S. Bank in a matter of minutes. U.S. Bank today announced the launch of Payment Switch , giving customers a faster way to move recurring payments – such as streaming services, cell phones and utility bills – to a U.S. Bank debit or credit card. With just a few taps in the award-winning U.S. Bank Mobile App, customers can now switch the payment method for recurring bills on the Bills Subscriptions dashboard – all without visiting every merchant site or third-party service. articles.summary: Contract rates moved higher through August while spot rates retreated from June levels The latest quarterly U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index – Rates Edition showed contract and spot rates following different paths from June through August. Produced in collaboration with DAT Freight Analytics, the report showed contract rates increasing while spot rates moderated from their June level. Dry van rates and volumes Dry van spot rates decreased from $2.38 per mile in June to $2.35 in July and $2.17 in August. Contract rates moved higher during the same period, rising from $2.30 per mile in June to $2.38 in July and $2.39 in August. By August, contract rates carried a premium of roughly $0.22 per mile over spot freight. Fuel costs also played a growing role in overall transportation spending. articles.title: U.S. Bank and DAT: Contract and spot truck freight rates diverge

articles.summary: Collaboration combines Updation's AI-powered dealership operations platform with U.S. Bank embedded payments capabilities K ey Takeaways Updation is integrating U.S. Bank Embedded Payment Solutions into its AI-powered dealership operations platform, creating a more connected experience for managing invoices, vendors and payments. The collaboration helps automotive, truck, RV and powersports dealerships reduce manual processes, improve financial visibility and streamline the movement of money. Through a bank-managed infrastructure, dealerships can access modern payment capabilities, including real-time payments, while benefiting from stronger controls and greater transparency. U.S. Bank and Updation, an AI-powered accounts payable, vendor management and contract management platform built for automotive dealerships, today announced a collaboration to help dealers streamline financial operations and manage payments more efficiently.
